yellow.$description: Full chroma, outside the yellow ramp. The 1984 theme's accent: fills, and text on a dark surface only.

urgent.$description: In the red ramp, at a step legible as text. Fills the timeline's overdue bar and a tag's text colour.

soon.$description: In the amber ramp, at a step legible as text. Fills the timeline's due-soon bar and a tag's text colour.

glow.$description: Warm amber, outside the amber and yellow ramps (nearest is yellow.350, #d0aa56). The start of the highlight gradient.

spotlight-error.$description: A muted rose, readable on the spotlight surface without the alarm of red.350. No ramp step is close. spotlight.error only.

ink.$description: Ink. All type, all rules, and the contrast surface. The light theme's actions and links.

concrete.$description: Concrete. The default page ground, and type on Ink.

orange.$description: Safety orange, the signal. In the themes it marks focus, the selected thing and one chart colour. Never a button or a link.

yellow.$description: Signal yellow. Full-bleed grounds in the brand, which Tenon has no token for. The themes read its ramp for one chart colour only.

steel.$description: Raw steel. Hairlines, inactive bars, and captions on Ink.

steel-dark.$description: Raw steel's stand-in on Concrete, for secondary text and borders. Literal: it is not on the steel ramp.

blue.$description: IBM blue. Technical diagrams and dense data, never beside orange.

ink-raised.$description: Panels on Ink in the dark theme. The brand sheet marks this one derived itself: Ink lifted one step.
